guida.titolo: Digital nomad visas: all countries compared & how to apply

avvertenza.frammento: Genki can't guarantee that a policy meets a specific visa's insurance requirements, so always confirm with the consulate or immigration office.

native_limiti.frammento: Genki Native is a separate sign-up, available up to age 55 and subject to health questions.

pt_d8.frammento: Genki Traveler covers the 12 month temporary stay track exactly. For the residence route, Genki Native runs with no end date, which matters here: it carries you through the 2 year permit and the long AIMA gap without a policy expiring mid-process.

it_dn.frammento: Genki Traveler is a travel health insurance in the medical sense: €1,000,000 cover for inpatient and outpatient treatment, matching the 12 month visa exactly. For annual renewals, Genki Native continues without an end date.

hr_dn.frammento: Genki Traveler caps at 12 months, so for the full 18 month permit Genki Native is the fit, it runs monthly with no end date and covers the whole window including the extension.

hu_wc.frammento: Genki Traveler covers the initial 12-month card exactly, with €1,000,000 medical cover far above the requirement. If you renew for the second year, Genki Native continues indefinitely.

hu_wc_cifra.frammento: Hungary requires health insurance valid for the whole stay with at least €30,000 coverage.

es_dn.frammento: Spanish consulates verify your insurer against an official list and often accept only policies from insurers licensed in Spain, so many international health plans are rejected on that basis, regardless of how good the cover is.

native_visto.frammento: We cannot guarantee that your visa will be approved, since that's up to the discretion of the authorities

escluse.schengen: MAI: Genki non dichiara nulla sul visto Schengen.
escluse.thailand-ltr-visa: MAI: la checklist BOI esclude l'assicurazione di viaggio e Genki non dichiara nulla sull'LTR.
